question: Should OpenClaw add a first-class expanded composer modal to the Control UI, or handle long-prompt friction through inline composer ergonomics and the existing send-shortcut setting?
rationale: This adds a new user-facing composer mode with draft, keyboard, focus, attachment, and send semantics rather than fixing a broken current contract.

options.title: Approve Expanded Composer Modal
options.body: Implement a scoped modal editor with Apply, Cancel/Close, Send, focus restoration, attachment handling, and modal-only Enter/Ctrl-or-Cmd+Enter behavior.

options.title: Prefer Inline Ergonomics
options.body: Improve long prompts through inline growth or resizing plus the existing shortcut preference without adding another composition mode.

options.title: Decline Modal Direction
options.body: Close the request by maintainer decision if Control UI composition should stay inline-only for now.

recommendation.title: Approve Expanded Composer Modal
recommendation.body: Implement a scoped modal editor with Apply, Cancel/Close, Send, focus restoration, attachment handling, and modal-only Enter/Ctrl-or-Cmd+Enter behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: They already reviewed this issue and own the strongest recent adjacent history on composer shortcut behavior.
